title: TinyEventEmitter & PromisePool
scenario: Build a typed event bus and a bounded asynchronous task coordinator for backend notification delivery.

milestones.title: Event Map & Listener Contracts
milestones.goal: Define generic event payloads and listener signatures so each event key remains associated with its payload type.

milestones.title: on, off & emit
milestones.goal: Implement instance-owned event subscriptions, safe removal, registration-order delivery, and snapshot behavior for listeners added during delivery.

milestones.title: Bounded PromisePool
milestones.goal: Execute task functions up to a validated concurrency limit, preserve input order, and capture each task outcome without stopping later tasks after one failure.

milestones.title: AbortSignal Cancellation & Cleanup
milestones.goal: Observe an optional AbortSignal, prevent queued tasks from starting after cancellation, preserve started outcomes, and release signal listeners when the pool settles.

review.note: The clarified milestones, scoped checks, reference implementation, and complete targeted mutants align with the chapter lab brief and have no public implementation leaks.
